title: UK Issues Travel Advisory For British Nationals Following Red Fort Blast
description: UK advises against travel to parts of India, including Jammu and Kashmir, Manipur, and areas near the India-Pakistan border, following the Red Fort blast.

title: Hague gives Pakistan more 'assurance' on hydel projects under IWT ambit
description: Pakistan has received further assurances from the Court of Arbitration regarding hydel power project designs on rivers under the Indus Water Treaty. The court's latest order expands its scope to cover all components of run-of-river projects. It also mandates that design references are compulsory during India's design phase.

title: Star Pacer Ruled Out As Zimbabwe Name Squad For Pakistan Tri-Series; Check Complete Team
description: The upcoming tri-series in Pakistan will serve as vital preparation time for the ICC Mens T20 World Cup next year. Zimbabwe etched their place as one of the 20 teams at the ICC Mens T20 World Cup next year in India and Sri Lanka, after completing a flawless run to win the T20 World Cup 2026 Africa Qualifier.

title: Borders with Pakistan, Bangladesh, Nepal on high alert after Red Fort blast
description: India has ramped up security measures along its borders with Pakistan, Nepal and Bangladesh following a poweful explosion near Delhi's Red Fort that killed eight people.

title: Is Hafiz Saeed Behind The Red Fort Blast? New Video Shows LeT Threatening India Of Attacks
description: A powerful blast near Red Fort metro station in Delhi killed at least 10 and injured 24. Vehicles were gutted, and authorities rushed fire tenders to contain the blaze. The National Investigation Agency is probing possible terror links amid recent LeT threats from Pakistan and Bangladesh.

title: Pakistan’s terror playbook expands East: How Hafiz Saeed is turning Bangladesh into ‘second front’ against India
description: The reactivation of old networks, visits by Pakistani military leaders, and growing religious radicalism in Bangladesh suggest that Islamabad is once again trying to build a “second front” against India, with Dhaka’s silence only deepening suspicions in New Delhi.

title: What will India do if Red Fort blast turns out to be Pakistan-backed terrorist attack?
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi had warned Pakistan that any future terrorist attack would result in a strong retaliation. - What will India do if Red Fort blast turns out to be Pakistan-backed terrorist attack?

title: Ex-Bangladesh Minister Alleges Pakistan's Bid to Influence Dhaka
description: Former Bangladesh Minister Mohibul Hasan Chowdhury claims Pakistan's ISI aims to turn Bangladesh into a 'vassal state' following Sheikh Hasina's ouster. Criticizing Nobel laureate Muhammad Yunus' government for aligning with Pakistani extremists, Chowdhury highlights Pakistan's historical use of Bangladesh for terror transit against India.

title: Yunus, Pakistan aim to turn Bangladesh into ISI's vassal state, alleges ex
description: Alleging that Pakistan used Bangladesh as a terror transit point against India between 2001 and 2006, former Bangladesh Minister Mohibul Hasan Chowdhury Monday claimed that the current objective, following the ouster of the Sheikh Hasina government, is to turn Bangladesh into a vassal state of Pakistan's spy agency, the ISI.
